plans.label: Fast
plans.notes: Optional faster inference of the same Opus 5.5 model. Claude API: speed="fast"; access is available in Start, Build and Scale tiers. Also available on Azure-hosted Microsoft Foundry. No Batch or Priority Tier combination. Cache and data-residency modifiers stack on Fast rates; switching speeds invalidates the prompt cache. Cache-use assumptions must describe requests at this speed.

plans.label: Standard
plans.notes: Implicit cache hits only; explicit cache writes and storage are unsupported. Thinking is billed as output. Calculator uses the 65,536-token synchronous output limit; input and generated tokens share the 1,048,576-token window.
